caption:
Some tasks are easier to look at than to start.
A 2013 review in Social and Personality Psychology Compass argues that procrastination often happens when a task feels unpleasant, and that it has a lot to do with feeling better right now. Source: Sirois and Pychyl 2013, Social and Personality Psychology Compass, https://doi.org/10.1111/spc3.12011
For whoever has a task they keep not starting.
